step1_issue.title: bug(state-scanner): _extract_status 提取过宽 → Status 长文本里 sub-task token 命中 fallback (us-036 reproduce)
step1_issue.body:
## Symptom

`scripts/collectors/_status.py` 的 `_extract_status` 提取整个 Status 字段 (包括 sub-task 状态描述 / 历史路径 / Archival blockers / 进展更新等长文本)，`_normalize_status` 在 fallback `done/complete` 阶段命中文本里的 token，错误归 lifecycle `done`，把 still-blocked spec 错放进 `openspec.pending_archive[]`.

## Reproduce

Project: `10CG/nexus` (private Forgejo); proposal: `openspec/changes/us-036-memory-conflict-resolution/proposal.md`

```python
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, ".claude/plugins/marketplaces/10CG-aria-plugin/skills/state-scanner/scripts/collectors")
from _status import _extract_status, _normalize_status

raw = _extract_status(open("openspec/changes/us-036-memory-conflict-resolution/proposal.md").read())
print(f"len(raw) = {len(raw)}")           # 1529
print(f"normalize = {_normalize_status(raw)}")  # done (WRONG)
```

Status 字段头部主语义 = `🟢 **Phase B Sprint 2 delivered**` (即 `implemented` lifecycle 且 archival_blocked), 但 1529 chars 里有 sub-task 描述 `"(3) ~~TASK-101 multi-seed~~ ✅ closed 2026-05-09 (PR #53 实质完成, docs sync 标 **done**; ...)"`. word-boundary `\bdone\b` 命中 → fallback `done`. 

## Root cause

`_extract_status` 当前用 `_STATUS_PATTERNS` regex 在整 proposal text 上抓 `> **Status**: ...` 段, 没限制段内长度 / 行数 / sentence 边界. nexus 等大型 spec 习惯把 status field 当 mini-changelog 写 (sub-task 状态 + 归档历史 + 阻塞项), 导致 raw 长达 1500+ chars, fallback token shadow 必然发生.

Aria #101 fix (commit `154775a` 2026-05-13) 已经修了 substring shadow (word-boundary matching) 和加 `implemented` token, 但**提取范围**没改 — 同一类 bug 的另一面.

## Proposed fix (任选一或组合)

1. **首行/首句截断**: `_extract_status` 只返回 Status 字段第一个 sentence (`.split(/[.。]/)[0]`) 或第一行 (`.split("\n")[0]`). 主 lifecycle 语义通常在头部.
2. **长度上限**: 截到前 N chars (N=200?), 截到则 log soft_error "status_field_truncated".
3. **加权限制**: 多行 Status 字段时, fallback `done/complete` 仅在首行内有效; sub-line 命中触发 soft_error 而非归 done.
4. **ignore 装饰文本**: skip strikethrough (`~~...~~`) / sub-bullet (`- ` / `* `) / 引用 (`> `) 在 Status 长文本里的内容.

推荐 (1) — 治本 + 简单. nexus us-036 的 Status 长描述实际是 useful narrative (写给人读), 不应该被 truncate. 但 normalizer 只看 lifecycle keyword, 首行/首句覆盖即可.

## Workaround (currently in place)

nexus PR #70 已 land (10CG/nexus 5c85400): us-036 proposal Status 首段加 `**implemented**` lifecycle keyword, priority 5 命中, 不再走 fallback done. 单点 workaround, 不解决其他可能受影响的 spec.

## Affected

any OpenSpec proposal whose `> **Status**: ...` 字段是 multi-line / multi-sentence narrative 且头部主语义 phrase 不含 normalizer 识别的 lifecycle keyword (delivered / shipped / done 但属于 sub-task 时). 

## Related

- Aria #101 (substring shadow 2026-05-13, commit `154775a`)
- aria-plugin v1.20.0 (本次 reproduce 使用版本)
- nexus PR #70 (us-036 workaround, 5c85400)

## Version info

- aria-plugin: v1.20.0 (manifest `marketplaces/10CG-aria-plugin/.claude-plugin/marketplace.json`)
- nexus: `5c85400` (after us-036 workaround merge)
- 复现日期: 2026-05-19

cases.input: Synthetic single-line Status field `> **Status**: 🟢 **Phase B Sprint 2 delivered** — archival blocked; ... docs sync 标 done; blockers: live verify outstanding` (178 chars) passed through _extract_status + _normalize_status imported from plugin cache v1.23.0 collectors/_status.py
cases.expected_behavior: normalize result is NOT 'done' — header semantics 'delivered' indicates an implemented-class / archival-blocked spec; a 'done' token buried in sub-task narrative must not shadow the lifecycle classification
cases.actual_behavior: _extract_status returns the entire 178-char single line (no length / sentence / first-line cap); _normalize_status falls through to the 'done' fallback via a word-boundary hit on the buried '标 done', returning lifecycle 'done'
